title: CardioTrace: A Web-Based ECG Simulator for Cardiac Rhythm Visualisation
description: Web-based ECG simulator that generates fifteen cardiac rhythms using a parametric Gaussian superposition model, for ECG education, algorithm benchmarking and synthetic data generation. Accompanies the paper 'ECG Simulator for Cardiac Rhythm Visualisation and Educational Applications'.
